info.name: Marketplace API v2
info.description:
Welcome to the MotionElements API.

This API will allow you to search, purchase and download MotionElements library of worldwide stock video and audio on your platform.

Endpoint

Live: https://api.motionelements.com/v2

Authentication:

To use our API, you will need to:

  1. Sign up for an account in MotionElements.com.
  2. Create your API secret key at Developer Console

Authentication is via HTTP Basic Auth. Use your API secret key as the basic auth username. No need to provide a password.

All requests must be made over HTTPS.

Sorting

The sorting format e.g. sort=credits,-created_at

Sorts by credits in ascending order (smallest first), followed by created_at field in descending order (latest first).

Pagination

Param Value
page 1
per_page 100

Standard parameters

To change the language or currency of the return data.

Param Value
language en, ja, ko, zh-hant ISO 639-1 language code in lowercase
currency USD, EUR, JPY, KRW, TWD ISO 4217 currency code in uppercase

urlencoded.description: Change language to: en - English, ja - Japanese, ko - Korean, zh-hant - Chinese (Traditional)

item.name: Elements

description.content: The Element’s unique identifier.

item.description:
Elements are stock video, music, video template.

The element object

Name Type Description
id string Unique identifier.
name string Name of Element.
new boolean Is it newly publshed?
exclusive boolean Is it exclusive to MotionElements?
usage_rights object Licensing and usage rights.
subscription boolean Is this Element downloadable via subscription?
free boolean Is it a free download?
price integer Price in cents.
currency string ISO currency code.
credits integer Price in credits.
artist object Contributor data.
media_type string Media type of Element.
media_type_details string Detail specifications.
keywords array Keywords.
previews object Video, music or large image previews.
thumbnails object Image thumbnails.
variants array Formats available for download.
published_at timestamp Date published in timestamp
categories array Categorization.
html.url array Product page URL
